prompt: Forecast next month's daily sales from three years of history with weekly and yearly seasonality.
why: Model trend and seasonality explicitly (Prophet, ETS, SARIMA).
trap: Plain regression ignores autocorrelation and seasonality.

prompt: Predict server traffic for the next 12 weeks, including the holiday peak, to plan capacity.
why: Seasonal forecasting with holiday effects and prediction intervals.
trap: Anomaly detection flags unusual traffic; it doesn't forecast it.

prompt: A utility needs hourly electricity demand for tomorrow, which depends on time of day, day of week and recent hours.
why: Lagged values plus daily and weekly seasonality: a time-series model.
trap: Treating hours as independent rows throws away the sequence.

prompt: Forecast weekly demand for 10,000 products so stores can reorder before they run out.
why: Many series forecast in parallel (often a global model with per-product history).
trap: Recommenders suggest products; they don't forecast quantities.
